Threshold sensitivity is not measurement error. Conditional monthly means are not an unbiased climatology.
Source: Pickart (2020), DOI 10.35090/fz80-6c32; original archive and first custody retained.
OSW prospective method v1; source traces and edge brackets accompany every result. No data admission.
Digits show calculation precision; physical uncertainty and annual current ranges are not established.
